patch.summary:
Thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.

Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs. Choose Cognism only if your buying job matches “Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong ” rather than Outreach's shape. Choose Outreach only if your buying job matches “Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packa” rather than Cognism's shape. Workflow advantage: Cognism leans data-enrichment, contact-management; Outreach leans sales-engagement, lead-management. Trade-off: you gain focus on one product's motion at the cost of the other's adjacent coverage — no universal winner.

Major differences:
- Buyer thesis: Overlapping use cases, different tradeoffs — Cognism and Outreach share buyer workflows; choose based on documented strengths and limits.
- Positioning: Cognism is Compliance-first B2B sales intelligence with phone-verified Diamond Data® mobiles, strong EMEA coverage, and CRM enrichment — quote-led Sale; Outreach is Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus/Pro packages; request pricing (seat + AI credits)..
- Workflow coverage skew: Cognism-leaning data-enrichment, contact-management vs Outreach-leaning sales-engagement, lead-management.
- Researched limits: Cognism — Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Outreach — Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core.

Limitations — Cognism: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach; Sales Prospecting Standard/Pro list prices are not published on /pricing; Outreach: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core; No published dollar pricing — enterprise quote only.

Poor-fit cases: Cognism is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a native email sequencer — push contacts into Outreach/Salesloft or CRM for outreach · Outreach is a poor fit when that limitation bites: Not a contact database peer — weak as SI data/enrichment core · Avoid Cognism if you actually need Outreach's motion (Enterprise sales engagement / AI revenue platform — Amplify Essentials/Core/Plus)

Neither product has a completed hands-on product test on SoftwareGlimpse — this comparison is research/data-based only.
